---
title: "Gating"
---

Automated gating with the openCyto framework.

## `sw_gate_template` {#sw_gate_template}

Build a gating template CSV.

### Usage

```r
sw_gate_template(output_file, template_type = "lymphocyte")
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `output_file` | Path for the output CSV file. |
| `template_type` | Template type. Currently supports `"lymphocyte"`. |

### Details

Writes a default CSV gating template suitable for a standard lymphocyte panel.
The template follows the openCyto CSV format and can be edited before use.
Includes gating strategies for singlets (FSC-A vs FSC-H), live cells
(viability dye negative), and lymphocytes (FSC-A vs SSC-A).

### Value

The file path (invisibly).

---

## `sw_gate_run` {#sw_gate_run}

Apply automated gating.

### Usage

```r
sw_gate_run(fcs_files, gating_template, transform_channels = NULL,
        transform_func = NULL, ...)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fcs_files` | Character vector of FCS file paths or a `flowSet`. |
| `gating_template` | Path to a CSV gating template. |
| `transform_channels` | Optional character vector of channels to transform before gating. |
| `transform_func` | Optional transformation function. |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `openCyto::gating()`. |

### Details

Full openCyto gating workflow: loads FCS files into a GatingSet, applies
optional transformation, and runs hierarchical gating using a CSV template.

### Value

A `GatingSet` object with gates applied.

---

## `sw_gate_extract` {#sw_gate_extract}

Extract gated populations.

### Usage

```r
sw_gate_extract(gs, node)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `gs` | A `GatingSet`. |
| `node` | Character string specifying the gate node to extract. |

### Details

Extracts `flowFrame` objects from a specific gate node of a `GatingSet`.

### Value

A named list of `flowFrame` objects, one per sample in the GatingSet.
